description: Stop watching a URL for good: its results and incidents are deleted. An open incident is closed first: the inbox you named gets a "removed" message, your owner a short email if they had the "down" one. Returns deleted: true; an unknown or already removed check_id answers check_not_found. Works after the plan ended.

check_id.description: The check's id (chk_...) from uptime_add or uptime_status.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

name: uptime_remove
title: Stop watching a URL
